name: Gostišče Tulipan
description: Traditionally furnished restaurant in Lesce serving original Slovenian dishes, some rooted in family recipes. Renowned for venison specialities.

name: Briška Hiša
description: Charming restaurant in the Brda vineyards offering Slovenian cuisine with Italian accents, well-curated local wine selection and cosy ambience.

name: Gostilna Pri Planincu
description: Third-generation family inn in Bled inside a traditional house, with a menu showcasing local Slovenian favourites.

name: Merjasec Alpine Hut
address: Top of Vogel cable car, Bohinj
description: Accessible mountain hut at the top of Vogel above Lake Bohinj. Stunning mountain views, Shepherd's lunch and hearty veal stew.

name: Bovec kitch'n
description: Tiny food stand in Bovec where father and daughter serve traditional Slovenian dishes with carefully curated ingredients. Quick local lunches to go.

name: Kosobrin
description: Wooden cabin in Kranjska Gora with cosy environment and short menu of hearty Slovenian fare; quick service for a fast lunch stop.

name: Fritula
description: Dessert stop in Radovljica serving traditional fried miške / fritula, eaten warm while strolling through the town square.
